heroSummary: South Western City Schools begins Wednesday, August 19, 2026 for grades 4–12 and K–3 students with last names A–G. K–3 groups H–O and P–Z begin August 20 and 21, and all K–12 students attend together on August 24. The planned last student day is Friday, May 28, 2027; six June dates are calamity contingencies, not confirmed class days.

calendarFaqs.q: When do all SWCS K–12 students attend together?
calendarFaqs.a: Monday, August 24, 2026 is the first full attendance day for all K–12 students after the three-day K–3 phase-in.

calendarFaqs.q: Is May 4, 2027 definitely a no-school day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. SWCS labels May 4 as a tentative Election Day closure subject to the Board of Elections primary date.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does this page show March 15, 2027 for the fourth grading period?
calendarFaqs.a: The graphic calendar prints March 15, 2026. SWCS's grade-card schedule lists March 15–May 28, 2027, which matches the 2026–27 school-year sequence used on this page.

calendarFaqs.q: Does SWCS publish a Spanish school calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. SWCS publishes an official Spanish version of the 2026–27 calendar; it is linked in the Downloads section above.
